_comment: DeathLink messages the ARK plugin sends when one of us dies. One line is picked at random from the
list for what killed us. Placeholders: {name} = the survivor who died, {dino} = the creature that did
it (its in-game name, e.g. Raptor or Alpha Rex; "a {dino}" becomes "an" before a vowel). A line with {dino}
is only used when the creature is known. Add as many lines as you like; an empty or missing list falls back to 'unknown'.
Kinds: carnivore, herbivore, alpha, trap (an Archipelago trap creature), player (another survivor),
drowning, starvation, dehydration, cold, heat, lava, falling,
unknown (anything the plugin could not identify).
carnivore: {name} tried feeding a {dino}, but the {dino} ate {name} instead
{name} found out the {dino} was not friendly
{name} tried to pet a {dino}. It did not go well
{name} offered the {dino} a berry. The {dino} wanted meat
{name} lost a staring contest with a {dino}
{name} was chased down and eaten by a {dino}
herbivore: {name} picked a fight with a {dino} and lost
{name} thought a {dino} was harmless. It was not
{name} punched a {dino} one too many times
{name} was stomped into the dirt by a {dino}
{name} tried to steal from a {dino} and paid for it
trap: {name} opened an Archipelago gift. It was a {dino}
{name} was killed by a {dino} someone sent as a present
player: {name} was taken out by another survivor
{name} lost a fight to a fellow survivor
drowning: {name} went for a swim and never came back
{name} held their breath for too long
{name} is now sleeping with the fishes
cold: {name} forgot to pack a fur coat
{name} went to the snow biome in a loincloth
heat: {name} forgot to bring a hat to the desert
lava: {name} went for a swim in lava
{name} took a dip in the volcano
falling: {name} found out the ground is hard
unknown: {name} met an unfortunate end on the ARK
